# Plass

> Plass is a UI component library that ships one design language for two frameworks: `plass-ui` on npm for React, and `plass_ui` on pub.dev for Flutter. Both hold the same components under the same names, the same prop vocabulary and the same tokens, and the two version independently.

Every component page covers both frameworks. The hooks, and the three components marked React only, exist in the React package alone. The links below are the English pages; the Korean ones are the same paths under `/ko/`.

## Guide

- [Getting started](https://plass.cdget.com/guide/getting-started): installing either package, the one-line CSS setup and dark mode
- [Setting defaults](https://plass.cdget.com/guide/defaults): setting `size`, `color`, `locale` and the rest once for everything below
- [Translating the words](https://plass.cdget.com/guide/locales): the words the components say about themselves, and the packs that translate them
- [Browser support](https://plass.cdget.com/browser-support): the oldest browsers the React package works in, and what decides them

## Examples

- [Admin dashboard](https://plass.cdget.com/examples/dashboard): a back office with a nav rail, figures and a table with bulk actions
- [Landing page](https://plass.cdget.com/examples/landing): a marketing page with a feature grid, pricing and an FAQ
- [Sign-up](https://plass.cdget.com/examples/signup): a three-step form with real validation

## Components

- [All components](https://plass.cdget.com/components/): every component on one page, each as a running preview

## Charts

- [PlAreaChart](https://plass.cdget.com/components/charts/area-chart): a line with the space under it filled, alone or stacked
- [PlBarChart](https://plass.cdget.com/components/charts/bar-chart): lengths compared, on an axis that starts at zero
- [PlGaugeChart](https://plass.cdget.com/components/charts/gauge-chart): one number on a known scale, drawn as a dial
- [PlHeatmapChart](https://plass.cdget.com/components/charts/heatmap-chart): a magnitude per cell, as a grid or a treemap
- [PlLineChart](https://plass.cdget.com/components/charts/line-chart): a value against time, or against anything else with an order
- [PlPieChart](https://plass.cdget.com/components/charts/pie-chart): parts of a whole, at a glance
- [PlScatterChart](https://plass.cdget.com/components/charts/scatter-chart): two numbers per point, and whether they move together
- [PlSparkline](https://plass.cdget.com/components/charts/sparkline): a word-sized chart with no axes, grid or legend
- [PlTimelineChart](https://plass.cdget.com/components/charts/timeline-chart): work against time, a row per thing and a bar per stretch of it

## Display

- [PlAppLogo](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/app-logo): a product's mark with its name beside it
- [PlAvatar](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/avatar): a picture of a person or a thing that is never an empty box
- [PlBadge](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/badge): a small mark in the corner of something else, such as an unread count
- [PlBlockquote](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/blockquote): somebody else's words, set apart from your own
- [PlBreadcrumb](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/breadcrumb): the trail of pages above the one being read
- [PlChip](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/chip): a compact token, such as a tag, a filter or a status
- [PlCodeBlock](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/code-block): a highlighted viewer for one line of code or a thousand
- [PlDataList](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/data-list): labels and the values that go with them
- [PlDataTable](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/data-table): a table that sorts, filters, pages and selects its own rows
- [PlDivider](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/divider): a rule between two things
- [PlGallery](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/gallery): a set of pictures in one of four layouts
- [PlHighlight](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/highlight): marks the words a reader is looking for inside text
- [PlHotKeys](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/hot-keys): a keyboard key, or a combination of them
- [PlIcon](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/icon): a glyph from any icon set, at a known size and colour
- [PlImage](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/image): a picture, with its space reserved and its failure drawn
- [PlList](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/list): a stack of rows on one sheet
- [PlMockup](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/mockup): a phone, tablet, monitor or laptop with anything on its screen
- [PlStat](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/stat): one figure and what has happened to it
- [PlTable](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/table): a grid of data, given as columns and rows
- [PlTextLink](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/text-link): a link, in a sentence or on its own
- [PlTimeline](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/timeline): a sequence of steps in the order they happen
- [PlTree](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/tree): a hierarchy opened one branch at a time
- [PlTypography](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/typography): the library's type scale, from `h1` to `overline`
- [PlVisuallyHidden](https://plass.cdget.com/components/display/visually-hidden): content for a screen reader and nobody else; React only

## Feedback

- [PlAlert](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/alert): a message about something that happened, set into the page it is about
- [PlConfirmProvider](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/confirm): one confirm dialog, asked for from anywhere and awaited
- [PlDrawer](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/drawer): a panel attached to one edge of the window, over the page or beside it
- [PlEmpty](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/empty): the place where there is nothing, such as an empty list or a failed request
- [PlMeter](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/meter): a quantity inside a range, drawn as a bar
- [PlModal](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/modal): a dialog that takes the page away until it is answered
- [PlOverlay](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/overlay): a scrim over the whole page that stops it being used
- [PlPopconfirm](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/popconfirm): a question asked beside the control that raised it
- [PlPopover](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/popover): a sheet that opens beside the thing that opened it
- [PlProgressBox](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/progress-box): progress as a row of small plates that light up
- [PlProgressCircular](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/progress-circular): a ring that fills, where there is no room for a bar
- [PlProgressLinear](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/progress-linear): a bar that fills as the work gets done
- [PlSkeleton](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/skeleton): the shape of something that has not loaded yet
- [PlToast](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/toast): a message that appears on its own, says what happened and leaves
- [PlTooltip](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/tooltip): a short label shown while the pointer or the focus rests on something
- [PlTour](https://plass.cdget.com/components/feedback/tour): a guided walk over a screen that already exists

## Inputs

- [PlButton](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/button): a control that runs an action
- [PlButtonGroup](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/button-group): a run of buttons that belong together
- [PlCalendar](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/calendar): a month on the page rather than in a popup
- [PlCheckbox](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/checkbox): a single yes or no
- [PlColorPicker](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/color-picker): a colour chosen by eye, on a saturation square and a hue rail
- [PlCombobox](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/combobox): a field you can type into and also choose from
- [PlDatePicker](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/date-picker): one day, chosen from a calendar in a popup
- [PlDateRangePicker](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/date-range-picker): a span between two days
- [PlDateTimePicker](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/date-time-picker): a day and a time in one popup
- [PlFieldset](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/fieldset): a named group of controls that answer one question together
- [PlFilePicker](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/file-picker): a box you drop files on, or click to open the file dialog
- [PlFloatingActionButton](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/floating-action-button): the one action a screen is about, floating over it
- [PlForm](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/form): a form that knows which of its fields is wrong
- [PlIconButton](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/icon-button): a round button with only a glyph in it
- [PlNumberField](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/number-field): a field that only holds a number
- [PlOtpField](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/otp-field): a row of one-character slots for a code or a PIN
- [PlPagination](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/pagination): the strip of page numbers under a long list
- [PlRadioGroup](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/radio-group): a set of options where exactly one is chosen
- [PlRating](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/rating): a score out of five as a row of stars
- [PlSegmentedButton](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/segmented-button): two or more choices in one pill, exactly one taken
- [PlSelect](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/select): one value chosen from a list
- [PlSlider](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/slider): a value chosen along a range
- [PlSwitch](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/switch): an on and off that takes effect at once
- [PlTextField](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/text-field): single-line or multi-line text input
- [PlTimePicker](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/time-picker): a time of day, chosen from columns
- [PlToggle](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/toggle): a button that stays down, and a group of them that share one state
- [PlTransfer](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/transfer): two lists and the buttons that move items between them
- [PlTreeSelect](https://plass.cdget.com/components/inputs/tree-select): a value chosen out of a hierarchy rather than a list

## Layout

- [PlAspectRatio](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/aspect-ratio): a box that keeps a proportion at any width
- [PlContainer](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/container): the space at the sides of a page, and an optional maximum width
- [PlFlex](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/flex): a row or a column and the gap between the things in it; React only
- [PlFooter](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/footer): the sheet at the end of a page
- [PlGrid](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/grid): a twelve-column row and the cells in it
- [PlHeader](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/header): the bar across the top of a page
- [PlPageLayout](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/page-layout): the skeleton of a page, with its header, footer, sidebars and landmarks
- [PlPanes](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/panes): regions with draggable handles between them
- [PlPortal](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/portal): children rendered somewhere else in the document; React only
- [PlScrollArea](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/scroll-area): a bounded box that scrolls, with the library's own scrollbar
- [PlScrollZone](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/scroll-zone): a strip of anything, scrolled in one direction
- [PlShow](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/show): content shown at some widths and not others
- [PlSidebar](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/sidebar): a column beside the content that becomes a drawer in a narrow window
- [PlStack](https://plass.cdget.com/components/layout/stack): things piled up, overlapping

## Navigation

- [PlAnchor](https://plass.cdget.com/components/navigation/anchor): a table of contents that follows the reader down the page
- [PlBackTop](https://plass.cdget.com/components/navigation/back-top): a button back to the top, shown once the page has scrolled far enough
- [PlBottomNavigation](https://plass.cdget.com/components/navigation/bottom-navigation): a row of destinations held against the bottom edge of the window
- [PlCommandPalette](https://plass.cdget.com/components/navigation/command-palette): everything an application can do, behind one field
- [PlFloatingBottomNavigation](https://plass.cdget.com/components/navigation/floating-bottom-navigation): a row of round destinations floating above the bottom edge
- [PlMenu](https://plass.cdget.com/components/navigation/menu): a list of actions that appears when something is pressed
- [PlMenubar](https://plass.cdget.com/components/navigation/menubar): the strip of words at the top of an application, each opening a menu
- [PlNavigationMenu](https://plass.cdget.com/components/navigation/navigation-menu): a site's navigation, where some destinations open a panel of more
- [PlStepper](https://plass.cdget.com/components/navigation/stepper): a process the reader is moving through, and where they are in it

## Surfaces

- [PlAccordion](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/accordion): a stack of sections that fold open
- [PlBox](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/box): a sheet of glass that groups content and does nothing else
- [PlCard](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/card): the sheet a screen is grouped onto, with title and footer slots
- [PlCarousel](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/carousel): a strip of slides, one of which is in view
- [PlChatBubble](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/chat-bubble): one message in a conversation
- [PlCollapsible](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/collapsible): one section that folds, standing on its own
- [PlHoverCard](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/hover-card): a preview of what is behind a link, shown when the pointer rests on it
- [PlHowToSteps](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/how-to-steps): numbered instructions, with what to do under each one
- [PlPill](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/pill): a floating lozenge holding a little live information
- [PlSpoiler](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/spoiler): content covered until somebody asks to see it
- [PlTabs](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/tabs): a set of panels, one of which is shown
- [PlToolbar](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/toolbar): a bar of controls with a start and an end
- [PlWindowPane](https://plass.cdget.com/components/surfaces/window-pane): a window drawn the way one of eight systems draws it

## Transitions

- [PlAnimateAppear](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-appear): a list of things settling into place one after another
- [PlAnimateBlink](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-blink): content pulsing between full opacity and a floor
- [PlAnimateCounter](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-counter): a number counting up to its value
- [PlAnimateFade](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-fade): content arriving or leaving on opacity alone
- [PlAnimateFloat](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-float): content drifting gently without going anywhere
- [PlAnimateGrow](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-grow): content unfolding from a point
- [PlAnimateHeadline](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-headline): one line replacing the one above it, on a timer
- [PlAnimateLighting](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-lighting): a light travelling around the outside of something
- [PlAnimateMarquee](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-marquee): content scrolling steadily past without end
- [PlAnimateReveal](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-reveal): content uncovered behind a moving edge
- [PlAnimateRotate](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-rotate): content turning about a point
- [PlAnimateScramble](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-scramble): a line of text resolving out of noise
- [PlAnimateShake](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-shake): a refusal, played when something is rejected
- [PlAnimateSlide](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-slide): content travelling in from one edge
- [PlAnimateSplit](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-split): a line of text arriving one part at a time
- [PlAnimateTyping](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-typing): text appearing one character at a time
- [PlAnimateZoom](https://plass.cdget.com/components/transitions/animate-zoom): content arriving from the middle of where it will end up

## Hooks

- [usePlBreakpoint](https://plass.cdget.com/hooks/use-breakpoint): which breakpoint the window is at, and a responsive value resolved there; React only
- [usePlColorScheme](https://plass.cdget.com/hooks/use-color-scheme): the dark mode toggle, and a script that prevents the flash; React only
- [usePlDisclosure](https://plass.cdget.com/hooks/use-disclosure): one boolean and the callbacks that change it; React only
- [usePlElementSize](https://plass.cdget.com/hooks/use-element-size): how big an element is, kept up to date; React only
- [usePlHotKeys](https://plass.cdget.com/hooks/use-hot-keys): keyboard shortcuts bound outside any one control; React only
- [usePlMediaQuery](https://plass.cdget.com/hooks/use-media-query): whether the window matches a CSS media query; React only
- [usePlOnScreen](https://plass.cdget.com/hooks/use-on-screen): whether an element is on screen; React only
- [usePlReducedMotion](https://plass.cdget.com/hooks/use-reduced-motion): whether the reader has asked for less movement; React only

## Design

- [Design language](https://plass.cdget.com/design/design-language): the tinted-glass rule, and the surfaces, shadows and motion that follow from it
- [Colour](https://plass.cdget.com/design/color): the six colour families, their measured contrast and how to override them
- [Right to left](https://plass.cdget.com/design/rtl): how every component lays itself out for a right-to-left language
- [Breakpoints](https://plass.cdget.com/design/breakpoints): the five named widths, and how to move them
- [Prop conventions](https://plass.cdget.com/design/prop-conventions): what the shared props mean, and the rules a new prop is named by

- [Full descriptions](https://plass.cdget.com/llms-full.txt): every page above described at length in one file, with the design language and the shared prop vocabulary
